Bangladesh Stuns Australia on Day One of Darwin Test

Bangladesh achieved a dominant position on day one of the first Test against Australia in Darwin, bowling out the hosts for 198. Tanzid Hasan Tamim made history by scoring a century, joining an elite list that includes Virat Kohli. Steve Smith also reached a milestone, equaling a significant record despite Australia's performance. The match saw Bangladesh secure a day-one stranglehold after a previous low score in a warm-up game.
